dates_comment: proposed fast-lane values of LIVE_TESTS_12.md 1.1; the ordered lane (a lapse) changes the three dates and the module constants together
k_tests_rule: the tests whose census gates all hold (section 7), a subset of [CH245, CH244]; fixed at registration, never changed; a census_dropped test is never re-censused, a census_unavailable (coverage) test may be re-censused only in the ordered lane as its own Holm family
code_sha_rule: normalised sha256 (SPEC_SHA256 line excluded) of every module in live_tests12.CODE_FILES
size_check_result_rule: per test {status: pass | fail_size_scenario | fail_mechanical_world, failed_size, failed_mechanical, analytic_oversized}; world 1's lambda recorded beside it
f_roles_rule: fixed per test by design (1.7 rolling states, 1.9), never by a census count; there is no f_binding key; live_tests12.f_role refuses any other value

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (bid > 0, ask < 1, bid < ask) and spread (ask - bid) <= 0.10 at k - 1 and k; one row per condition_id; tick known and equal at k - 1 and k

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; the event is excluded)

crypto_rule.rule: vendored-only: read by the copied category_cols; LT12 classifies crypto with crypto_classifier (crypto7)

series_key_rule: vendored-only (category_cols' skey); LT12's series family is 1.4.3's: the first sidecar series_slugs entry after strip and casefold, empty -> none:<event key>

crypto_classifier.rule: 1.4: both primaries exclude crypto by this classifier; unknown is counted and treated as crypto
crypto_classifier.failsafe: if no distinct fee_category value of the whole sealed sidecar set contains 'crypto' the classifier is not shown to work and the census is refused (every gate NaN)

rv.rule: as LT11 (LT11 ambiguity A5): at least 10 observed 2 h changes in the 12-slot window

k_block.rule: 7 / 1.7: filled from the committed header pre-check BEFORE the seal; true -> the column enters K as an indicator pair; the seal and every census refuse while null

tiers.rule: 1.4.2: cost-model-v1 liquidity bins of the row's liquidity (< $1k, $1k-10k, $10k-100k, >= $100k); missing -> NaN, excluded, counted

feed.rule: 1.2: the last usable feed capture (manifest state complete, rows file present) whose start is before capture k - 1's start and at most 6 h earlier, else feed_uncovered; feed-listed = the condition_id with a positive-rate configuration; CH244 only; never a state, control or target

seeds.derived_rule: non-binding runs on generators 20261597 x 100 + n (1.8, 1.8.1); development x 100 + 99 and timing x 100 + 98 are never the registered seed

gates.statistic: event-clustered CR1 t of the tested coefficient on the gate sample (events with n_e >= 16), the observed refitted on it
gates.perm_method: event-phase state-shift: raw state shifted with one offset per event on [s_e, n_e - s_e], s_e = max(4, ceil(n_e / 4)); expanding-past event x UTC-day demeaning re-applied every draw

inference.p_rule: p = max(p_event on t with G_event - 1 df, p_two-way normal, p_day on t with G_day - 1 df)
inference.demeaning: expanding-past, stratum event x UTC day, strictly earlier captures (LT12 ambiguity A13)

size_check.rule: a failing binding scenario sets only its own test to 'SE check failed'; k unchanged; no rerun

census_inputs.lt12_seal_note: written by run_live_tests12.py seal (q0711) after the design-text freeze and after the span and its lag slots have ended; committed before the census
census_inputs.window_rule: captures from 12 slots before the span ([2026-11-06T00:00Z, 11-07T00:00Z), look-back only) to 3 slots after it (to 2026-11-17T04:31Z, twins only)
census_inputs.covered_days_rule: covered origins / 12, a covered origin being a sealed span slot whose capture and the capture of the slot before it are both sealed with rows, sidecar and manifest; for twin pairs also the captures of slots k + 2 and k + 3; from the seal manifest, before any row is read; identical for both tests
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / covered days; distinct-event gates and '>= 48 units' counts use the UNPROJECTED counts

mde_common.rule: every MDE gate is max(declared, design) (7); declared = the closed formula at the census's effective counts, DE_gate, sqrt(max(1, VIF_w)) (CH245: the gap divided by s_w; CH244: the four-cell variance); design = 3.47 x 1.5 x SD x se_1 from the census regressors after the expanding-past event x UTC-day demeaning under LT8's working covariance; F-MDE = max(design-based MDE of Delta, MDE x sqrt(2 / (1 - max(0, r_gate)))); NaN fails; DE_gate = max(5.0, 1 + (m_21 - 1) x 0.02); t_sum = max(3.47, exact)

census_fixed_rule: 7's exhaustive list (k_tests is item 1), filled with the exact census floats (8.4 step 5); exclude_family is "" when no family was excluded; rho_census is null with rho_census_nan true when the census correlation is NaN (zero variance), and world 1 then fails by 1.8.1's rule
census_gate_values_rule: recorded census gate values (7: 'recorded, never re-used to change a threshold'); mde_c is the input of 1.9's 'underpowered' label only
informed_labels_rule: 1.1 / 1.9: null until the pin, then {test: [labels]} filled from the ledger ([] only when none applies); registration refuses while null. CH244's 'informed (E022)' is certain and added by the analysis itself (live_tests12.CERTAIN_INFORMED); never removable; never a verdict

economics.hurdles: cost-model-v1 (COST_MODEL.md), reported in the analysis; never a verdict
